plan.notes: Source: University of Cincinnati Blue Ash College official 'Associate Degree in Nursing Technology — Nursing Department Student Handbook 2025-2026' (uc.edu), 'Sequencing of Nursing Program Courses' (p. 18). Per standing rules, the official program handbook takes priority over the general catalog. Catalog year is printed on the handbook. 'Students admitted to the nursing program are required to take all nursing courses and co-requisite/non-nursing courses as outlined in the semester nursing curriculum plan.' Minimum grade of C required for all nursing and non-nursing courses. Credit sums verified: 18+18+14+14 = 64. The Spring Year 1 math slot is MATH 1008 or STAT 1031 (3 cr) — transcribed as a choice. The Spring Year 2 general-education slot is one 3-cr Breadth of Knowledge elective from FA, HP, or HU — transcribed as a disclosed generic slot. ACEN-accredited, Ohio Board of Nursing approved. No TCCNS in Ohio; transfer_confidence is empty.
